The biggest enemy in the trenches might not be the market. It might be our own impatience.

They say 99% of traders lose. In memecoins, I wouldn't be surprised if the odds are even worse.

I'm watching wallets constantly buy and sell for $0.35 profit, sometimes at a loss, only to jump into another coin.

Add trading fees, slippage, and bad entries, and those small losses slowly eat away at your capital.

Everyone wants a 10x, but few have the patience to let a thesis play out.

Instead of chasing every new launch, why not spend more time finding communities with committed teams, recognizable memes, and people who actually build?

That's what keeps me interested in $WASTED.

The CTO is still working. The community is still active. The meme isn't going anywhere.

Holding isn't automatically the right decision, but neither is trading yourself into a smaller bag every day.

Sometimes doing less, managing risk, and letting a good thesis develop is the smarter play.

You can't catch every runner. But you can stop being exit liquidity for every one of them 🫵🏼

The entire market is getting WASTED right now.

Bitcoin bleeding. Stocks bleeding. Fear everywhere. People panic selling at a loss just to rotate into another coin that's probably bleeding too.

Still holding around $800K. Around 9,000 holders. CTO team still building. Community still showing up despite everything we've been through.

And look at the meme itself.

Clash Royale, ESPN, SportsCenter: we're seeing WASTED style content across gaming and sports.

That's the beauty of this meme. It doesn't need crypto to stay relevant.

Got rugged? WASTED.
Lost the game? WASTED.
Market crashed? WASTED.

We're not guaranteed anything, but recognizable culture, committed leadership, and a battle-tested community are ingredients I wouldn't overlook.

The real test of conviction isn't when everything is green. It's when the market gives you every reason to lose hope.

If the thesis hasn't changed, don't let fear make the decision for you.

We've been knocked down countless times.

And what do we do?

WASTED. RESPAWN. REPEAT.

pinnedUpdate.content:
Some coins launch. Others are born into survival mode.

I've been following WASTED since the day 1, and honestly, the community has been through more than most projects survive.

Look at what they've endured.

• Day 1: Original dev dumped and disappeared. Community had to take over and rebuild from scratch.

• Two major holders fully clipped around $1.6M MC, sending it crashing to $400K.

• A $31K whale overhang added more selling pressure and uncertainty.

• An ETH version emerged, competing for the same narrative and attention.

• Old dev links, FOMO risk warnings, repeated selloffs, and people constantly writing the project off.

Yet somehow, the community kept showing up.

Now look at the daily chart.

Higher lows. Repeated resistance tests. Back near $1.86M MC in this snapshot.

That's what caught my attention.

Not just the recovery, but the people who stayed through every setback.

The funniest part? The coin is literally based on GTA's iconic death screen.

They got WASTED. They respawned. Again and again.

The chart still needs to prove itself, but the community has already shown serious resilience.

And with the GTA VI attention cycle ahead, the narrative is getting interesting.

The strongest lore isn't always invented. Sometimes it's earned through survival.

WASTED 💀

PS: I have my supply on Exfil App.
